verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government and Prime Minister Modi are not offering any free mobile recharge scheme. Messages and videos promoting this offer are part of a recurring scam designed to steal personal information.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple official sources, including the Indian government itself, have explicitly and repeatedly stated that no such free recharge scheme exists. Numerous fact-checking organizations have debunked this claim over several years, consistently identifying it as a phishing scam intended to collect users' personal data. The claim reappears periodically, often tied to major events like elections or festivals, sometimes using edited or AI-generated videos of the Prime Minister.
